description: This file contains utility functions related to voice wake word detection and command processing in a Swift application. It provides methods to normalize tokens, detect trigger words at the start of transcripts, and process text commands based on wake words and trigger phrases.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a string token by trimming whitespace and punctuation, then converting to lowercase.

methods.name: startsWithTrigger
methods.description: Checks if the transcript starts with any of the given trigger phrases, considering tokenization and normalization.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Processes the transcript to determine if it contains a wake word and trigger, returning the trimmed command if criteria are met.
